t: The Controller is your main interface to the Reprocessor.$(br2) Right-click on the Controller to open its graphical user interface. From there, you can turn the Reprocessor on or off, check the amounts of fluids and energy present in the machine, and monitor the status of the current reprocessing job.
控制器是你与再处理器交互的主要界面。$(br2)右键点击控制器即可打开它的图形用户界面。在那里，你可以开关再处理器、查看机器内的流体和能量存量，以及监控当前再处理任务的状态。
If you hover over a control in the interface, a tooltip will appear, providing additional information or explanatory text for that control.$(br2)
如果你将鼠标悬停在界面中的某个控件上，就会出现一个提示框，提供该控件的额外信息或说明文字。$(br2)
